phase_types.title: Load
phase_types.description: Cold load only: unload the profile if it is loaded, then load it without sending any chat request and wait until it is ready.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

phase_types.title: Warm-up
phase_types.description: Send requests that are recorded but left out of the statistics, so a cold cache does not skew the measured ones.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: count
options.description: How many warm-up requests to send.

options.name: request
options.description: The request to send (default: the first request of the requests phase).

phase_types.title: Requests
phase_types.description: The measured requests: each prompt is sent `repeats` times and statistics are computed over them.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: requests
options.description: The prompts or chats to send.

options.name: repeats
options.description: How many times each request is sent.

options.name: cache_prompt
options.description: Default for requests that do not set it: reuse the cached prompt.

options.name: max_tokens
options.description: The most tokens one answer may have.

options.name: temperature
options.description: Sampling temperature; 0 makes the output repeatable, so its hash can be compared between runs.

options.name: seed
options.description: Sampling seed.

options.name: stream
options.description: Stream the answer, which also measures the time to first token.

phase_types.title: Conversation
phase_types.description: A multi-turn exchange: each turn is sent with all earlier turns and the model's replies, which measures how much of the prompt the server reuses.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: system
options.description: An optional system message that starts the conversation.

options.name: turns
options.description: The user's messages, in order.

options.name: cache_prompt
options.description: Let the server reuse the cached earlier turns.

options.name: max_tokens
options.description: The most tokens one answer may have.

options.name: temperature
options.description: Sampling temperature; 0 makes the output repeatable, so its hash can be compared between runs.

options.name: seed
options.description: Sampling seed.

options.name: stream
options.description: Stream the answer, which also measures the time to first token.

phase_types.title: Hold
phase_types.description: Keep the model loaded and idle for a while, then send one request to see how it behaves after the idle time.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: seconds
options.description: How long to stay idle.

options.name: request
options.description: The request sent afterwards (default: the first request of the requests phase).

phase_types.title: Simultaneous requests
phase_types.description: Send n requests to the same profile at the same moment and record each one's wait and decode speed, the total time and the errors.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

options.name: n
options.description: How many requests to send together.

options.name: request
options.description: The request every one of them sends (default: the first request of the requests phase).

phase_types.title: Unload
phase_types.description: Unload the profile and record how long it takes until the instance is gone.

options.name: label
options.description: A name for this phase, shown in the progress view.

request_options.name: name
request_options.description: A short label for the request (default request-N).

request_options.name: prompt
request_options.description: The prompt, sent as one user message. Give this or messages.

request_options.name: messages
request_options.description: A full chat: a list of {role, content}. Give this or prompt.

request_options.name: cache_prompt
request_options.description: Let the server reuse the cached prompt; off means every request does its full prefill.

request_options.name: max_tokens
request_options.description: The most tokens one answer may have.

request_options.name: temperature
request_options.description: Sampling temperature; 0 makes the output repeatable, so its hash can be compared between runs.

request_options.name: stream
request_options.description: Stream the answer, which also measures the time to first token.

turn_options.name: name
turn_options.description: A short label for the turn (default turn-N).

turn_options.name: content
turn_options.description: What the user says in this turn.

turn_options.name: max_tokens
turn_options.description: Overrides the phase's max_tokens for this turn.

benchmark_options.name: id
benchmark_options.description: Lower-case letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_'; up to 64 characters.

benchmark_options.name: description
benchmark_options.description: What this benchmark does and measures, shown while it runs.

benchmark_options.name: profile
benchmark_options.description: The profile (or alias) of this scheduler to benchmark.

benchmark_options.name: phases
benchmark_options.description: What to do, in order. Without phases the simple form (cold, warmup_requests, requests, repeats, unload_after) is used.

benchmark_options.name: timeout_s
benchmark_options.description: Limit for the whole benchmark, load and holds included.

expect_keys.name: outcome
expect_keys.description: What the scheduler should do: ready (default), refused (it declines before loading) or failed (the load fails).

expect_keys.name: max_load_s
expect_keys.description: The load must take at most this long.

expect_keys.name: min_decode_tps
expect_keys.description: Mean decode speed must be at least this.

expect_keys.name: min_prefill_tps
expect_keys.description: Mean prompt-processing speed must be at least this.

expect_keys.name: max_ttft_ms
expect_keys.description: Mean time to first token must be at most this (needs a streamed phase).

expect_keys.name: output_sha256
expect_keys.description: The first request's output must hash to this (needs temperature 0).

expect_keys.name: min_reused_tokens
expect_keys.description: Every turn after the first must reuse at least this many prompt tokens from the cache.

expect_keys.name: max_concurrent_wall_s
expect_keys.description: All simultaneous requests together must finish within this time.

expect_keys.name: max_errors
expect_keys.description: At most this many simultaneous requests may fail (default: not checked).

expect_keys.name: max_unload_s
expect_keys.description: The instance must be gone within this time of the unload.

templates.name: Load only
templates.description: Measures just the cold load of a profile: how long it takes, how many bytes go to which worker and how much memory it uses. No chat request is sent.

benchmark.name: Load only
benchmark.description: Cold load, then unload. Measures load time and upload rate only.

templates.name: Load and requests
templates.description: A cold load, one warm-up, then measured requests repeated several times, then unload.

benchmark.name: Load and requests
benchmark.description: Cold load, a warm-up and 3 measured requests.

requests.name: explain
requests.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a GPU does.

templates.name: Load and conversation
templates.description: A cold load followed by a multi-turn conversation, to see prefill, decode and how much of the earlier turns the server reuses.

benchmark.name: Load and conversation
benchmark.description: Cold load, then a 3-turn conversation with prompt caching.

turns.content: Name three uses of a hash table.
Give a one-line example of the second one.
Now summarise our conversation in one sentence.

templates.name: Requests on a loaded model
templates.description: No load and no unload: sends requests to whatever is loaded (the model is loaded first if it is not).

benchmark.name: Requests on a loaded model
benchmark.description: Measured requests only; leaves the model loaded.

requests.name: explain
requests.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a GPU does.

templates.name: Simultaneous requests
templates.description: Loads the model, then fires several identical requests at once to see how the scheduler and the model share the time.

benchmark.name: Simultaneous requests
benchmark.description: Cold load, then 4 requests at the same moment.
